paragraphs: R' Yehudah, son of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.
Mentioned in [Niddah 15a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.15a.4) and likewise in [Tosefta Niddah, chapter 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Niddah.3.3).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Mishnah gives Rabbi Yehudah as the son of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. The [Gemara](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.15a.8) repeats the ruling.
The linked Tosefta gives the same ruling and titles the father Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai. Hyman’s heading retains Rabban.
